notes: New Piano tab: a full keyboard colored by scale degree with the same palette as the fretboard - keys follow your key/scale from the bar, labels switch between notes/intervals/degrees, every key plays a real piano sound, the scale plays at your tempo, and Jam chords light up the keys live. Also fixes practice pauses: up-and-down runs can now rest at the bottom, the TOP of the scale, or both sides - and a rest is never skipped after changing patterns mid-run.
